interview.hardest_part: Navigating the hotel efficiently from intermittent screenshots while controlling aim with fixed half-second arrow-key inputs. The smoke and fire near the ground floor will make route recognition and threat detection especially difficult. Full marks also require substantial combat, healing, revival, and survival milestones beyond simply completing the chapter.
interview.likely_failure: Losing time through repeated wrong turns or getting stuck near obstacles, particularly after the elevator, then becoming separated from teammates or taking sustained damage while trying to recover. Even if I finish the chapter, I am likely to miss the highest kill counts, special-infected counts, and teammate-revival milestones.
interview.helpful_mechanics: Easy difficulty and three AI teammates provide substantial combat support, rescue from incapacitation, and some healing. Shoves help create space against nearby infected, automatic fire reduces repeated input demands, and the game pauses while I inspect screenshots. Route milestones award partial credit even if I fail to finish.
interview.harmful_mechanics: Fixed-duration keyboard turning makes precise aim and small navigation corrections difficult. Only one action can be selected per step, so firing, shoving, reloading, and interacting must be sequenced. Special infected can disable movement, smoke and flames obscure the route, and teammates can take kills needed for my milestones. Healing and revival milestones depend on available supplies and suitable opportunities, while rendering and deliberation consume the wall-clock budget.
